slides.label: Wildlife oxygen science
heading: Every species is different.
The need for oxygen is universal.
slides.description: BHOC Therapeutics is developing a next-generation oxygen carrier designed to support veterinary medicine, including wildlife, exotic and endangered species. By improving oxygen delivery at the microcirculatory level, we aim to help more animals survive when every second counts.

reference.alt: Science Bridge visual with a gray wolf and a red blood cell to BHOC molecule size comparison

photo.alt: Close portrait of a gray wolf with amber eyes

comparison.alt: A red blood cell compared with a BHOC molecule, shown as more than 400 times smaller

benefits: Compatible with all blood types for all species.
3+ year shelf life at room temperature.
slides.closing: Advancing oxygen delivery for a wilder tomorrow.

companion.heading: Built for veterinary teams.
companion.description: From emergency care to any situation where oxygen delivery is compromised.
